text:
You need a Canada housing-data SaaS that combines aggregated market data with calculators and AI to surface the best real estate investment opportunities.

I’m Noor Halden, and I build Python-based machine learning and NLP systems. On Parcelwise Logistics, I built a WhatsApp and SMS delivery support chatbot with Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio; it resolved 43% of conversations without an agent. For a legal client, I built a contract clause search assistant with Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, pgvector, PostgreSQL, and FastAPI; it achieved 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question test set and cut clause lookup from 25 minutes to 3 minutes.

For your SaaS, I can help design the data ingestion, scoring logic, and AI-assisted calculators around your themeforest UI. What Canada housing data sources are you planning to start with?
